method: Verify the six files in the appended RC13 layer against the digest record; scan all six release binaries and every OCI blob for PEM private-key blocks and Tencent SecretId/SecretKey assignments.

false_positives_noted.generic_PRIVATE_KEY_strings: Rust TLS and crypto dependencies contain error strings such as failed to parse private key. These are code constants, not PEM blocks or key material.
false_positives_noted.base_layers: The RC12 base layers were retained byte-for-byte. The scan did not find PEM private-key blocks or Tencent credential assignments in any retained OCI blob.

conclusion: No private keys, seeds, tokens, Tencent cloud credentials, or PEM private-key blocks were found in the RC13 additions or the assembled OCI archive.
